description: Builds the Desk's league table for a team's flight, with the named team's place, which it ranks from recorded results by the league's own rule and tie-breaks. Call it for the standings, how a team finished, who won the league or 'the table'. Pass the team name, or nothing for the member's own team. For a whole league, pass `league` and `area` instead, such as "55 & over men's 8.0" and 'Marin'. Never pass a club or an area as the team.

area.description: The area of that league, as the Desk names it, e.g. 'Marin' or 'San Francisco'. Used only with `league`.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

league.description: A league to build the table of when no team is named, with every league word the question gives, the age group included: its name, e.g. 'Adult 55 & Over Mens 8.0', or its words, e.g. "55 & over men's 8.0" or "women's combo 6.5 daytime". Used only without `team`.

season.description: League year, e.g. 2025. Defaults to the current season.

team.description: Team or club name whose league table to build, e.g. 'Belvedere' or 'Belvedere mixed 8.0'. Omit to use the signed-in member's own team, or to ask by `league`. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_league_standings
title: A league table
